quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Two local relationship-entry candidates, not verified lodging buyers: Emmanuel Everbecq, Regional Director and head of Transport and Infrastructure Western Switzerland, can potentially route a request to local administration; Gianluca Cantinotti, HR Business Partner, can potentially route training/onboarding questions. Programme-specific contacts are Monika Garcia, fire-safety course administration, and Bojan Stevanovic, course leader. Their published roles establish relevance, not hotel contract authority.
findings.futureEdition: No officially announced activity with an exact date, city and venue was located for 8 December 2026–30 June 2028 in the French, English and German sources reviewed. Next announced edition within that horizon: none found. The published fire-safety calendar ends on 26 November 2026; 19 and 26 November are still upcoming as of 17 November, but outside the requested window. The 27 May 2026 date is a news publication date, not a course date. The Geneva office became operational on 1 January 2026, also outside the horizon. Do not infer 2027 recurrence or mobilisation from these facts.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel brief: YOTEL Geneva Lake is a conditional corporate day-meeting, training or visiting-team prospect, not a qualified room-block lead. Six meeting rooms could accommodate the published 5–10-person BIM course format, but that is below the supplied 20–120-room group guideline and the source specifies client-premises delivery. No course attendance may be converted into guestrooms. Founex is not central Geneva; the new Geneva office does not establish demand willing to lodge in La Côte. For Renens/Lausanne, no travel evidence was found that participants arrive via Geneva Airport or lodge toward Nyon/La Côte/Geneva. No French Pays de Gex activity verified. No resort requirement established; do not position this as resort demand. Catering capacity remains unverified.
findings.venueCommitments: No future-horizon event venue verified: venue, city and region remain null. An explicitly dated course outside the horizon is Brandfallsteuerungen richtig planen, 26 November 2026, at Leonardo, Thurgauerstrasse 80, 8050 Zürich, canton Zürich, Switzerland — elsewhere, not the target corridor. LEONARDO is an office/conferencing property, not evidence of a Leonardo hotel booking. Gruner’s Geneva office is Boulevard James Fazy 8, 1201 Genève — Geneva city, not Founex/Nyon/La Côte. Its Renens office is Rue de la Gare de Triage 5, 1020 Renens, Vaud — Lausanne area, not La Côte. Neither office address establishes an event venue.
findings.historicalRotation: No destination-rotation sequence established. Published BIM Foundation sessions were 10–11 June, 17–18 June and 30 September–1 October 2026, at clients’ premises without a named city or venue. A separate fire-safety panel took place on 4 June 2026 in Zürich; the 19 August article date is not its activity date. These are different programmes, not successive editions of one rotating event.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Unknown; no verified housing bureau, hotel room block, open lodging RFP, overnight package or named hotel incumbent for Gruner demand in the target territory. Quote from BIM training: “On-site training at client's premises”; this describes delivery location, not lodging procurement. Quote from the fire-safety course: “Ort: Leonardo, Thurgauerstrasse 80, 8050 Zürich”; this confirms a meeting location only. The LEONARDO property website mentions nearby “Hotels (Radisson, Kameha Grand, ibis)” generically: none is an edition-specific Gruner hotel commitment. No Gruner–Radisson lodging commitment or competitive overflow verified. Silence must not be classified as sourcing open.
findings.organizationStructure: Gruner is a corporate engineering and planning group, not an association, PCO or DMC. Local operating names include Gruner SA in Geneva and Gruner Stucky SA in Renens. Its courses are professional education sold by the engineering business. No external meeting or housing agency was identified for the activities reviewed.
findings.competitiveLimitations: No sourced incumbent hotel, exclusive accommodation agreement, sold-out condition or overflow evidence. This is not evidence that inventory is independently bookable. The confirmed out-of-horizon Zürich course venue and client-premises BIM format limit immediate capture; the latter could remove any need for an external meeting room. Generic nearby-hotel marketing is not procurement evidence.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Ask Gianluca Cantinotti to identify the Romandie training/office-travel coordinator and whether any 8 December 2026–30 June 2028 programme has exact dates, an external meeting requirement and overnight travellers. Ask Emmanuel Everbecq’s administration to validate any Geneva/La Côte project visits and the actual purchaser. Request meeting location, participant origins, peak rooms, stay pattern, approved hotels/framework agreements and decision timing before quoting. Offer a small day-meeting/site visit first; propose rooms only after corridor lodging is confirmed. For public fire-safety courses, approach Monika Garcia only to ask whether a Romandie off-site programme is planned; no relocation assumption.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: No sales-accessible event or dated project mobilisation verified within the requested horizon. The 26 November 2026 Zürich course is outside both horizon and territory. Current corporate presence in Geneva/Renens is not an accessible hotel booking. Hold event-led qualification pending a real brief; no assertion of centrally contracted or freely bookable lodging is justified.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Unproven, conditional relationship-development potential only. General recurring course provision is documented, but no exact 2027/first-half-2028 edition, local hotel brief or competitive rebid was located. Seek incremental off-site training or visiting-project teams only if dates, corridor location, overnight need and independent purchasing are confirmed; do not pitch displacement of an alleged Radisson block.
